finalText:
**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

One real bug, in `orderTotal`. It taxed the pre-discount base. The doc comment said tax the discounted amount.

Only 3 rows had both a discount and a tax. Those were the 3 failures.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Fix is at [src/pricing.js:40](src/pricing.js:40). Nothing else needed.
